content.text: {"role":"COO","professional_background":"Rose through plant management and regional supply chain leadership before taking enterprise operations responsibility for multi-site manufacturing and distribution. Has led two large system consolidations, a warehouse automation rollout, and a post-merger integration of operating processes. Comfortable with process engineering methods and shop-floor realities; spends significant time with site leads, planners, and frontline supervisors.","decision_priorities":["Impact on throughput and service reliability","Fit with existing operating processes and workflows","Realistic implementation burden on site teams","Vendor support depth during rollout and after","Quality of operational data for daily decisions"],"risk_attitude":"Accepts calculated risk when disruption can be contained by phased rollout and tested fallbacks.","time_horizon":"Weighs near-term stabilization alongside multi-year operating capability.","organizational_constraints":["Limited bandwidth of site leaders already carrying change initiatives","Legacy equipment and systems with uneven integration readiness","Capital planning cycles shared with other functions","Union and works council consultation on process changes"]}
